example.english: The noise deprived us of a good night's sleep.
example.chinese: 噪声使我们没能好好睡一觉。

example.english: The notice explains how to dispose of old batteries.
example.chinese: 通知说明了如何处理旧电池。

703.meaning_zh: 进一步了解；接着采取行动

collocations.english: follow up an email with a call
collocations.chinese: 发邮件后再打电话跟进

example.english: I'll follow up your suggestion at the next meeting.
example.chinese: 我会在下次会议上进一步讨论你的建议。

704.meaning_zh: 就此而言；在这方面同样如此

collocations.english: or anyone else for that matter
collocations.chinese: 或者其他任何人也是如此

collocations.english: or at any time, for that matter
collocations.chinese: 或者在任何时候也是如此

example.english: I wouldn't say that to a colleague, or to anyone else for that matter.
example.chinese: 我不会对同事说那种话，对其他任何人也不会。

705.meaning_zh: 为了某人的利益；为帮助某人

collocations.english: for the benefit of new students

example.english: I'll explain it again for the benefit of those who arrived late.
example.chinese: 为了让迟到的人也能听懂，我再解释一遍。

collocations.english: for the sake of the children

example.english: Let's keep the instructions short for the sake of clarity.
example.chinese: 为清楚起见，我们把说明写简短些吧。

707.meaning_zh: 做了某事却未受惩罚；侥幸逃脱

example.english: He thought he could get away with copying the homework.
example.chinese: 他以为抄作业也能蒙混过关。

example.english: Given that we're short of time, let's focus on one example.
example.chinese: 考虑到时间有限，我们集中看一个例子吧。

709.meaning_zh: 心中想着；考虑某个人选或方案

collocations.english: have someone in mind for the job
collocations.chinese: 心里已有这个职位的人选

example.english: Do you have a particular place in mind for the meeting?
example.chinese: 你心里有想好的具体会面地点吗？

collocations.english: have nothing to do with the problem
have nothing to do with me

example.english: This question has nothing to do with the previous topic.
example.chinese: 这个问题与上一个话题毫无关系。

example.english: Please organise the files in accordance with the instructions.
example.chinese: 请按照说明整理文件。

collocations.english: in any case, it's too late

example.english: I may be late, but in any case, please start without me.
example.chinese: 我可能会迟到，但无论如何，你们都先开始，不用等我。

713.meaning_zh: 能够；处于可以做某事的境地

collocations.english: be in a position to help
be in a position to decide
collocations.chinese: 处于可以作决定的地位

example.english: We're not yet in a position to give you an answer.
example.chinese: 我们目前还无法给你答复。

collocations.chinese: 结合其他工具一起使用

example.english: Use the audio in conjunction with the written examples.
example.chinese: 把音频和书面例句结合起来使用。

example.english: I'm writing in connection with your request for more information.
example.chinese: 我写信是为了回应你了解更多信息的请求。

716.meaning_zh: 实际上；实质上；正在生效

collocations.chinese: 实际上是一次新的开始

example.english: By changing all the details, we were in effect starting again.
example.chinese: 我们改动了所有细节，实际上等于重新开始。

example.english: Please read the instructions in full before you begin.
example.chinese: 开始之前，请完整阅读说明。

example.english: The changes are in line with the feedback we received.
example.chinese: 这些改动与我们收到的反馈一致。

example.english: The idea sounds simple, but how does it work in practice?
example.chinese: 这个想法听起来简单，但实际操作起来怎么样？

collocations.english: in respect of the services provided

example.english: Please provide further details in respect of your application.
example.chinese: 请提供关于你申请的进一步详情。

collocations.english: in such a way that everyone can see
collocations.chinese: 以让每个人都看得见的方式

collocations.english: in such a way as to avoid confusion

example.english: Arrange the chairs in such a way that everyone can see the screen.
example.chinese: 把椅子摆成让每个人都能看见屏幕的样子。

collocations.english: in the absence of the manager

example.english: In the absence of clear instructions, we waited.
example.chinese: 因为没有明确指示，我们选择等待。

collocations.english: in the course of the day
in the course of a discussion

example.english: Several useful ideas came up in the course of the discussion.
example.chinese: 讨论过程中出现了几个有用的想法。

collocations.english: in the event of a delay

example.english: In the event of a delay, we'll send you a message.
example.chinese: 如果出现延误，我们会发消息通知你。

example.english: The team remained calm in the face of unexpected difficulties.
example.chinese: 面对意料之外的困难，团队保持了冷静。

726.meaning_zh: 掌握在某人手中；由某人负责

collocations.english: in the hands of an expert

example.english: The final decision is in the hands of the committee.
example.chinese: 最终决定权掌握在委员会手中。

collocations.english: in the light of new information
in the light of recent events

example.english: We changed the plan in the light of your comments.
example.chinese: 我们根据你的意见调整了计划。

example.english: The new room will be ready next week; in the meantime, we'll use this one.
example.chinese: 新房间下周能准备好，在此期间我们先用这一间。

collocations.english: in the midst of a discussion

example.english: The phone rang in the midst of our discussion.
example.chinese: 我们正在讨论时，电话响了。

730.meaning_zh: 在某人面前；有某人在场

collocations.english: in the presence of a teacher

example.english: He felt nervous speaking in the presence of his new manager.
example.chinese: 当着新经理的面讲话，他感到紧张。

collocations.english: in the wake of a storm
in the wake of the announcement

example.english: Several questions arose in the wake of the announcement.
example.chinese: 公告发布之后出现了几个疑问。

example.english: Her involvement in the project began last year.
example.chinese: 她从去年开始参与这个项目。

example.english: I don't have time for a short walk, let alone a whole afternoon out.
example.chinese: 我连短暂散步的时间都没有，更别提花整个下午出去。

example.english: At that stage, the plan was little more than an idea.
example.chinese: 在那个阶段，这个计划还仅仅是个想法。

example.english: She managed to live on a small income while studying.
example.chinese: 求学期间，她设法靠微薄的收入生活。

example.english: You may well find the second version easier to use.
example.chinese: 你很可能会觉得第二个版本更好用。

collocations.chinese: 看起来与图片完全不同

example.english: The finished room looks nothing like it did before.
example.chinese: 装修后的房间看起来与以前完全不同。

collocations.english: not to mention the extra work

example.english: Moving would take weeks, not to mention the cost.
example.chinese: 搬家要花好几周，更不用说费用了。

example.english: I'd like to thank you on behalf of the whole team.
example.chinese: 我想代表整个团队向你表示感谢。

740.meaning_zh: 由某人表现出来的；就某人的行为而言

collocations.english: an effort on the part of everyone

example.english: The success required a real effort on the part of everyone.
example.chinese: 这次成功需要每个人切实付出努力。

collocations.english: over the course of a year
over the course of the meeting

example.english: My confidence grew over the course of the year.
example.chinese: 这一年里，我的信心逐渐增强。

example.english: To put it simply, we need more time.
example.chinese: 简单地说，我们需要更多时间。

example.english: The study seeks to understand how people learn new words.
example.chinese: 这项研究试图了解人们如何学习新词。

example.english: The new service is set to begin next month.
example.chinese: 这项新服务定于下个月开始。

collocations.english: the extent to which it helps
collocations.chinese: 它发挥帮助作用的程度

collocations.english: the extent to which things have changed

example.english: We need to understand the extent to which the changes affect users.
example.chinese: 我们需要了解这些变化对用户产生多大影响。

example.english: This is our most successful event to date.
example.chinese: 这是我们迄今最成功的一次活动。

collocations.english: be up against a strong team

example.english: We're up against a tight deadline this week.
example.chinese: 我们这周面临一个紧迫的截止期限。

example.english: With regard to your question, I'll send the details tomorrow.
example.chinese: 关于你的问题，我明天会把详细信息发给你。

example.english: We need more information with respect to the total cost.
example.chinese: 关于总费用，我们还需要更多信息。

collocations.english: with the exception of one person

example.english: The library opens every day with the exception of Sundays.
example.chinese: 这家图书馆除了星期日以外每天都开放。
